Team —

We have our weekly prep ahead of Monday's finance commit. Goal: make a short, prioritized list of deals that close the gap to our Q3 commit and surface blockers that need cross-team action (pricing, security, legal). Quick asks: please update stages in HubSpot by EOD Monday and drop a one-line status in this thread for any deal you expect to move into Commit or Commit-At-Risk.

Target metrics I want on the sheet for Monday:
- Coverage ratio (pipeline / quota) by segment (SMB / Mid / Enterprise)
- Weighted commit total vs. target
- Top 6 deals to defend/accelerate with owners and blockers

I'm attaching a heatmap snapshot I generated from the current exports — it's noisy but useful for prioritization. Call tomorrow 10:30am PT to annotate the heatmap and lock the commit.

Attachments: Q3_pipe_coverage_heatmap_v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

Thanks,
Sean
